batch: Phase B3 -- final T3 growth batch, remaining ~349 verb candidates after B1/B2
method_note: First-pass keyword matching against M-code themes produced a ~20%% false-positive rate (e.g. 'testify' matched on 'test', 'hold fast' matched on 'fast'/fasting, 'get along well' matched on 'long'/desire, 'capture alive' matched on 'alive'/life-death, several 'return'/'in turn' phrases falsely matched 'turn'/repentance) -- every one manually re-checked for actual sense before inclusion, none applied blindly. 60 candidates excluded entirely: empty gloss text (cannot classify without guessing), copula/existential forms, proper-noun/place/person epithets hiding behind verb-majority morph tags, and adverbial 'quickly' forms -- same categories already found in Phase B2.
